The Lab/2013

The freelance years begin

2013–2014 · Design & development

My teenage freelance portfolio, while I was working at MakeUseOf.

Archived site · 18 June 2013 ↗

The homepage text survives in Wayback. The original stylesheet and project thumbnails are still missing.

Dates & sources

The page’s supporting files are dated October 2013; its surviving HTML was last modified on 9 January 2014.

I was working as a freelance designer and front-end developer, and had started working with MakeUseOf. My portfolio included their main site, MakeUseOf TV, a music website and Webstiles.

I’d already written out how I worked with clients, from the first questions through drafts and feedback to the finished site. Webstiles was both a project in the portfolio and something I used in that process.

The HTML remains, but the stylesheet and project thumbnails are missing. You can read the original introduction below; the old design hasn’t been reconstructed.

Hello, I’m Namanyay Goel, a freelance designer & front end developer. I also work at MakeUseOf as their UI designer/front end developer.From the original homepage
